observations: Photo 0 shows a large FDM 3D printer with a blue printed robot model on the build plate. The brand 'ELEGOO' is visible on the top frame.
The printer has a black metal frame with vertical rails labeled 'NEPTUNE 3 MAX' on both sides.
A touchscreen control panel is attached to the front right side of the printer.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the printer's build plate with a grid of 63 points illuminated, labeled '63-POINT AUTO LEVELING'. The brand 'ELEGOO' is visible on the bottom right of the build plate.
Both photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JI TOVIDE BUSINESS WORLD'.

claims.claim: The Elegoo Neptune 3 Max is a reliable large-scale FDM 3D printer designed for printing very big...
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a large printer with a large printed object, consistent with a large-scale FDM printer. The model name is visible on the frame.
Photo 1 clearly shows a grid of 63 points on the build plate with text overlay confirming '63-POINT AUTO LEVELING'.

risks.risk: The printer may not be functional or may have been disassembled or damaged.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the printer powered on, with the extruder moving and the touchscreen responding.

risks.risk: The printer may be missing critical components such as the power supply, filament spool, or software.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included parts laid out, including the power cable, filament, and any software or documentation.

risks.risk: The build plate or frame may be warped or damaged, affecting print quality.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the build plate surface and frame joints, showing no warping, cracks, or misalignment.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the printer powered on and operational.
Photo of all included parts and accessories.
Close-up photo of the build plate and frame for damage inspection.
response.reason: The model and key features are confirmed from the photos, but functionality, completeness, and physical condition cannot be verified remotely. Proof of operation and included parts is needed before pricing.
